data.description:
## Description

What: Add a code-quality job (or step) to .github/workflows/ci.yml that converts existing tooling output — ruff (Python), actionlint (workflows), shellcheck (bash) — into SARIF and uploads it via github/codeql-action/upload-sarif. Why: The Require code-quality ruleset rule needs code-scanning-API data from quality tooling to gate against, otherwise enabling it would permanently block PRs. Scope IN: SARIF emission from the three named tools and upload-sarif. Scope OUT: enabling the ruleset rule (draft-4), CodeQL security analysis (draft-1).


## Done Definitions

- On a PR, the code-quality job emits SARIF aggregating ruff, actionlint, and shellcheck findings and uploads it via github/codeql-action/upload-sarif, producing a code-quality analysis visible via the code-scanning API ← Satisfies: sc-2
- A PR introducing a ruff/actionlint/shellcheck violation produces a corresponding code-scanning alert from the uploaded SARIF ← Satisfies: sc-2

## Considerations

- [Maintainability] Prefer each tool's native SARIF output where available (ruff --output-format=sarif) over a hand-rolled converter to reduce drift.
- [Security] Same security-events: write requirement as the CodeQL job; scope the token narrowly.
- [Correctness] draft-1 (CodeQL) and draft-2 (ruff/actionlint/shellcheck) both upload to the same code-scanning API keyed by (ref, tool.name, category); assign a unique stable category per upload (or emit one merged code-quality SARIF under a single category) and document the chosen category names so draft-4's ruleset rule can target them. Otherwise a later upload overwrites the earlier analysis on the same (ref, tool.name, category) key and findings are silently dropped. (red/blue accepted finding 3, implicit_shared_state)

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a code-quality maintainer, I want lint/static-analysis output emitted as SARIF and uploaded, so that the Require code-quality rule has data to gate against.
